media_type.description: Target media type (e.g., DVD-R, DVD+R, BD-R, BD-RE)

backup_mode.description: Backup mode: full, incremental, or accumulate

verify_mode.description: Verification mode: full, incremental, or thorough

sources.description: List of source directories or files to include in backup

destination.description: Optional destination directory for partial backup (if omitted, only media is used)

exclude_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from backup

preserve_perms.description: Whether to preserve file ownership and permissions during restore

force_full.description: Whether to force a full backup despite incremental mode setting

log_file.description: Path to write operation logs (if omitted, no log file is written)
